title: Warning not to disturb the earth

tellings.quote: don't when you disturb the earth, negative things happen.

plain: When you dig into the ground at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, "negative things happen". Brandon Fugal, who owns the ranch, tells Michels that he was warned of this around 2016, passing on what someone told him. If true, the land itself would be reacting to being dug up.
